svg.title: Pear-shaped helium balloon with a highlight, knot and curling ribbon.
svg.desc: A party balloon that reads as an object: slightly narrower at the knot than a circle, a paper highlight on the upper left, a triangular knot, and a thick curling string. Birthdays, openings, kids, congratulations. Not a hot-air balloon and not balloon-bunch. Body accent, highlight paper, knot accent2, string ink.
